archetypes.name: dyn-cli-removal
archetypes.rationale: Dead CLI removal touches registry, re-export, and bootstrap helper imports.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the removed implement step-0-bootstrap surface for stale references or import fallout. Confirm bootstrap invoke and implement step-0-degraded-gate still resolve through the registry. Check that the env baseline changes match the deleted bare env reads rather than masking new violations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
